cases.rationale: base^T + base is recognized as symmetrized regardless of operand order; real random weights are non-local.

A bare parameter (no add/transpose at all) is the 'param' recipe path -- real random weights are genuinely non-local (locality passes) but the construction gives no self-adjoint guarantee (fails independently).
expected_locality is a required input_constraints field; omitting it must fail closed, never default to a guess.
torch.diag(base) is not a recognized construction; even though it IS actually local, VISTA must not guess -- it stays undetermined.
base + 2*base^T is a scaled adjoint, not the direct paired-add the analyzer recognizes; correctly left undetermined.
output_contracts roles must be unique; a duplicated xc_energy role fails closed regardless of locality.
